area: testbed hardening: the victory-cinematic fallback proven against real corrupt documents

find.report_claim: cycle 143 recorded that a missing or corrupt campaign_clear.kpath 'falls back to first person and records why instead of breaking the victory screen', and cycle 143's evidence was cited as a robustness guarantee
find.live_evidence: the only proof was a monkeypatched CameraPathLibrary.load that raised ValueError, which exercises one exception path and never touches real file parsing, so truncation, empty files, non-object JSON, an unsupported schema and a file with no keys were all unproven
find.consumer_evidence: a designer hand-editing the .kpath (the reason it is DATA) can produce exactly those five shapes; the reader had to be exercised through its real JSON path to know the fallback holds

killed: trusting the monkeypatched test: it stubs the loader, so it cannot show that the loader's real failures are the ones the game catches
swapping the shipped file for a corrupt one in the repo data dir: it is an untracked authored asset with no git restore path, so a failed run could destroy the only copy
adding the corrupt cases to the shipped document's directory: it would leave debris next to a real asset
analyze.survivor: redirect the game's library to a temp directory of genuine files via a module-level factory, then drive the real reader over five corrupt shapes plus a missing directory

fix.shooter: tests/test_campaign_camera_path.py adds a _RedirectedLibrary factory and a parametrized test over truncated JSON, an empty file, a non-object document, an unsupported schema and a keyless document, plus a missing-library-directory case; each asserts the campaign still clears, no camera path engages, the report carries an error, and the camera stays on the player's eye

shooter.repro: a direct probe of the five corrupt shapes and a missing directory showed every case recording 'could not load camera path' with no camera engaged and no exception
shooter.mutation: narrowing the except tuple from (KeyError, OSError, TypeError, ValueError) to ZeroDivisionError failed 7 tests (the five corrupt shapes, the missing directory and the existing monkeypatched fallback); shooter/game.py restored byte-identically (sha256 match)
